tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtsa gsum gter srung sgrol byed nag po'i gsol mchod bzhugs/1$0000300 na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī yai/

gter srung sgrol byed nag po la gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol na/ bshos bu dmar nag gnyis rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis brgyan/ chang bu dmar nag gnyis/ gzhan yang 'bru sna sha chang sogs kyis brgyan pa la/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod rjes/ hūm̐: che mchog bde chen 'khor lo yi: bka' nyan bdud kyi rje dpon ni: li yul dur khrod mun pa can: lcags ri nag po'i mkhar nang na: brag rdzong mtshon cha 'bar 'dra ba'i: gnas nas sku skyod 'dir gshegs shig: hūm̐: rje dpon gshin rje khros pa'i gzugs: ral pa nag po'i thor cog la: thod skam gsum gyi cod pan can: chibs su bdud rta rting dkar chibs: na bza' ber chen nag po gsol: phyag g.yas mdung dmar dar nag phyar: g.yon gyi zhags pas dgra bo yi: mgul pa bcings nas rjes su 'dren: lha bdud 'bum gyi rje dpon mdzad: g.yas kyi ru 'dren gza' bdud 'bum: g.yon gyi ru 'dren klu bdud 'bum: slad kyi rjes 'brang dmu bdud 'bum: 'khor dang bcas la mthun pa'i rdzas: rin chen ting lo zur brgyad dang: lcags mkhar nag po zur dgu pa: dgra bo'i lus srog dmar bshus pa'i: drag po'i rgyal mtshan ba dan phyar: mkha' lding nag po steng na 'phyo: bshos bu dmar nag chang bu dang: sdom sdig sbal sbrul srog chags gzugs: bar snang khams kun khyab pa yi: mthun pa'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: bka' bsgos dam las ma 'da' bar: che mchog bde chen 'khor lo yi: bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: bsam don phrin las khyod kyis sgrubs: hūm̐: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: gza' bdud gzer gyis rnam par gzir: klu bdud kha rlangs mun pas gtibs: dmu bdud 'bum gyis khram la thob:

lha bdud 'bum gyis lus srog phyes: gang la 'phen pa drag po'i stobs: thog ltar 'phen cing 'brug ltar sgrogs: khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol pa yi: phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'chi bdag bdud kyi rje dpon: gter srung sgrol byed nag po: lcam mo klu sman dkar mo: las byed gdug pa sde bzhi: rtsa ba gsum gyi gter srung 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ dam nyams rtsad nas chod cig mā ra ya sid+dhi phaṭa: dgra bo'i srog la nṛ hur thuṃ dza: khaṃ shag ro myag rbad: ces phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma gtsang sar skyel/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā ba nāṃ/ zhes pas rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o// //
